quotations.old_english: Ðæt cyrtel wæs unslitten,... Cuoedon: Ne tóslíte (scindamus) ué hiá
quotations.english: the coat was unrent ... They said: Let us not rend it

source_text: un-sliten; adj. Unrent :-- Ðæt cyrtel wæs unslitten,... Cuoedon: Ne tóslíte (scindamus) ué hiá the coat was unrent ... They said: Let us not rend it, Jn. Skt. Lind. 19, 23. [Icel: ú-slitinn.]
